items.title: FiGuRO: Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Multi-Modal Data
items.summary: Learns how many dimensions a multi-modal dataset really needs, split into shared and modality-specific subspaces, using fidelity-guided low-rank projections. Also works post hoc on pretrained unimodal models.

items.title: MultiLoReFT: Decoupling Shared and Modality-Specific Subspaces in Multimodal Learning via Low-Rank Representation Fine-Tuning
items.summary: Low-rank representation fine-tuning on frozen unimodal encoders that separates shared from modality-specific information, for multimodal prediction without large paired datasets.

items.title: Can sparse autoencoders make sense of gene expression latent variable models?
items.venue: Machine Learning in Computational Biology (MLCB), oral
items.summary: Tests what sparse autoencoders recover from the latent spaces of gene expression models, on simulated data and pretrained single-cell models, and introduces scFeatureLens to link SAE features to gene sets.

items.title: MultiDGD: A versatile deep generative model for multi-omics data
items.summary: Extends the Deep Generative Decoder to paired single-cell multi-omics data, modelling gene expression and chromatin accessibility in one shared representation.

items.title: The Deep Generative Decoder: MAP estimation of representations improves modeling of single-cell RNA data
items.summary: Learns cell representations by MAP estimation without an encoder, with a Gaussian-mixture prior over the latent space.

items.title: N-of-one differential gene expression without control samples using a deep generative model
items.summary: Uses a generative model of healthy tissue expression to call differentially expressed genes in a single sample, without matched controls.

items.title: A manifold learning perspective on representation learning: Learning decoder and representations without an encoder
items.summary: Frames representation learning as manifold learning and shows that a decoder and its representations can be learned jointly, without an encoder.

items.title: NetTCR-2.0 enables accurate prediction of TCR-peptide binding by using paired TCRα and β sequence data
items.summary: A convolutional network that predicts TCR-peptide binding from paired CDR3α and β sequences, showing that both chains together improve accuracy.
